The site assessment currently has a "Soil & Site" sheet that records the planned perc rate. Adding a dedicated perc test tab would let the installer log actual readings right there during the visit.

**What I'd want**

- New "Perc Test" sheet with hole ID, drop in inches, time interval
- Auto-computed perc rate per hole
- Average across all holes

**Why**

Right now I run the perc test on paper and the site assessment separately. Combining them saves a step.
